summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed a Form 6-K confirming a 1-for-3 reverse stock split effective June 5, 2026, reducing shares from ~698.7M to ~232.9M. No fractional shares issued; rounding up or down applies. Registered shareholders must submit certificates with a letter of transmittal to Odyssey Trust Company. The split also consolidates multiple voting shares at the same ratio to preserve relative rights. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation, as it does not involve acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change. The filing is a standard announcement with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
